title: AI-Powered Customer Churn Prevention for Telecoms
subtitle: Reducing customer churn by 29% and recovering £22M in at-risk annual recurring revenue for a major UK telecoms operator
summary: Data Panther built a real-time customer churn prediction and intervention system for a major UK telecoms operator, reducing annual churn by 29% and protecting £22M in recurring revenue through personalised retention offers.
challenge: A major UK telecoms operator with 8.5 million consumer and SME subscribers was experiencing an annual customer churn rate of 18.3% — significantly above the industry average of 14.5%. The retention team operated reactively, contacting customers only after they had already submitted a cancellation request ('save' calls), by which point the probability of retention was low and the concessions required to retain them were expensive. The company lacked any systematic ability to identify customers showing early signals of dissatisfaction before they reached the point of cancellation. The existing CRM system contained rich behavioural data — usage patterns, service call history, billing disputes, network experience scores — but this data was siloed and never systematically analysed to predict churn risk.
solution: Data Panther built a real-time churn prediction platform that ingested 140+ features from the client's CRM, billing, network operations, and customer service systems. A gradient-boosted churn risk model, trained on 36 months of historical data covering 2.1 million customer lifecycle events, produced weekly churn probability scores for every active subscriber. Critically, Data Panther also developed an offer optimisation engine — a contextual bandit model trained using historical retention campaign outcomes — that recommended the minimum-cost intervention (ranging from a loyalty discount to a service upgrade or a proactive network fix) required to retain each at-risk customer. At-risk customers identified 45–90 days before their predicted churn date received personalised outreach through their preferred channel (email, app push notification, or proactive agent call). The system was integrated with the client's Salesforce CRM and marketing automation platform (Braze) for seamless execution.
results: Annual churn rate reduced from 18.3% to 13% — a 29% relative improvement
£22M in at-risk annual recurring revenue protected in the first 12 months of operation
Cost of retention reduced by 38% per saved customer through targeted minimum-cost offers vs. blanket discounts
Proactive intervention 45–90 days before churn increased retention success rate from 21% (reactive 'save' calls) to 54%
Net Promoter Score (NPS) among the at-risk cohort improved by 14 points following personalised proactive outreach
Platform scaled to full 8.5M subscriber base within 6 months of initial pilot covering 500K customers
